scope.goal: Explain protocol construction and independently reproducible fields, not replace an API client with UI automation.
scope.limitation: No valid security factors generated; no new backend requests, account access or orders performed in this investigation.

fields.origin: Concrete request class plus business API selection; builder lowercases both using Locale.US.
Request data JSON after public business parameter injection and optional priority data insertion; not the HTTP form body itself.
DMBase request helper defines source/OS/app type; channel_from comes from i9; platform default injection is conditional. Not proof that every Dolores or Ultron request has identical extras.
Business version uses AppConfig.n versionCode; h9 version header and SDK appVersion use versionName. These are not interchangeable.
AppConfig.l combines initialized ttid string resource, @damai_android_, and versionName; registered into MTop runtime.

h9 caches Android device, OS, network, SIM and locale observations, then builds request headers. Some paths omit private identifiers. Header values may already be encoded before generic converter processing.
SDKUtils.getCorrectionTime(), not an arbitrary fixed timestamp.
Mtop getters read SDK XState; initialization involves device identifier providers/manager. Actual identifiers are not available from static constants.
Account/session runtime, not values to invent from package metadata; no values extracted here.
MTop configuration and SecurityGuard-backed app-key lookup by configured index; not a general substitute for security factors.
SecurityGuard Unified/MiddleTier/securitybody outputs; branches and null handling vary. Not all are always present, and wua is not simply another name for mini-wua.

transport.header_encoding: AbstractNetworkConverter.buildRequestHeaders URL-encodes mapped non-null values using Java URLEncoder UTF-8; upstream headers may have separate encoding.
transport.form_encoding: NetworkConverterUtils.createParamQueryStr encodes both keys and values, iterates map order, and appends literal null for a null encoded key/value; it does not sort entries.
transport.warning: JSON serialization, header encoding, HTTP form encoding and signer input are separate stages; synthetic matching metadata does not establish server acceptance.

new_plugin_evidence.discovery: libsgmain.so, libsgnocaptcha.so and libsgxdata.so are ZIP/APK containers with classes.dex despite their .so suffix.
new_plugin_evidence.native_boundary: InnerSignImpl -> unified security dynamic proxy -> plugin router -> JNICLibrary.doCommandNative
new_plugin_evidence.limit: The call boundary is confirmed; native internals, all runtime dependencies, security factor portability and backend verification rules are not recovered.

cross_version_verification.limit: Obfuscated class names/methods may change meaning across versions. Missing selected signatures do not prove missing functionality. Four mismatches do not alone establish semantic differences.

established: byte identity of the three selected plugins across sampled versions/ABIs
not_established: standalone generation of server-valid security factors
complete native algorithm or runtime-environment reconstruction
independent client successful order query or creation
feasibility.decision: Do not present an unsigned probe, UI navigation, copied device headers, or plugin decompilation alone as a working independent App-equivalent API client.
